name: Hoshino Ayaka
source: A super idol at the top of the charts. [url=http://vndb.org/c11693]Yuusaku[/url] meets her by accident and introduces her to [url=http://vndb.org/c11686]Miina[/url]. She immediately takes a liking to both Miina and Yuusaku and decides to live with them.
